question:
The marks scored by 10 students are given below.

12, 14, 14, 15, 12, 16, 12, 10, 19, 11

The mode of the given data is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The mode of a data set is simply the value that appears with the maximum frequency.

In the given data: 12, 14, 14, 15, 12, 16, 12, 10, 19, 11

By observation, the number 12 appears the most (3 times).

**∴ The correct answer is 12 marks.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marks scored by 10 students: 12, 14, 14, 15, 12, 16, 12, 10, 19, 11

**Formula Used:**

Mode = The observation having the highest frequency

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let us arrange the given marks in ascending order to easily count their frequencies:

⇒ 10, 11, 12, 12, 12, 14, 14, 15, 16, 19

⇒ Frequency of 10 = 1

⇒ Frequency of 11 = 1

⇒ Frequency of 12 = 3

⇒ Frequency of 14 = 2

⇒ Frequency of 15, 16, 19 = 1 each

⇒ Since the mark 12 occurs the maximum number of times (3 times), it is the mode.

**∴ The correct answer is 12 marks.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mean

The arithmetic average of a set of given numbers. Formula: Mean = Sum of all observations ÷ Total number of observations.

Median

The middlemost value of a sorted data set. If the total observations (n) is odd, Median = ((n+1)÷2)th term. If n is even, Median is the average of the (n÷2)th and (n÷2 + 1)th terms.

Empirical Relationship

For a moderately skewed distribution, the relationship between Mean, Median, and Mode is given by: Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean.
